description:
Query stored traces with filters, pagination and sorting; optionally with the dashboard summary.

What it does. Read-only, local. Exact-match agent_name and framework, inclusive since and until, and min_score and max_score on each trace's latest evaluation. limit is 1..1000 (default 50), newest first by default. A crossed range is refused, never returned as an empty page. Full detail: iris://capabilities.

When not to use it. To score a trace (evaluate_output) or create one (log_trace). As a live stream: poll with backoff.

Returns. JSON: traces, total, limit, offset, summary.

Errors. IRIS_STORAGE_ERROR. Out-of-range bounds are refused, naming the values; no match is total 0, not an error. Failures return {"error":{code,message,recovery}} with isError; follow recovery.

Siblings. log_trace — record an execution; evaluate_output — score one output; delete_trace — remove one trace.

agent_name.description: Filter by agent name — exact match (no wildcards)

framework.description: Filter by agent framework — exact match (e.g., langchain, autogen)

include_summary.description: Include dashboard summary stats in same response — saves a round-trip when ingesting for dashboards

limit.description: Results per page (default 50, max 1000 — values above are rejected)

max_score.description: Maximum eval score filter (0..1; values outside are rejected) — applied to LATEST eval per trace

min_score.description: Minimum score (0..1) of each trace's latest evaluation; at most max_score

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset — skip first N results (non-negative integer)

session.description: Filter by session id — the turns of one conversation, as logged with session_id

since.description: Inclusive lower bound, an ISO 8601 timestamp or date; anything else is rejected

sort_by.description: Sort by timestamp | latency_ms | cost_usd (default timestamp)

sort_order.description: Sort order: asc | desc (default desc — most recent / highest first)

until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (or date) upper bound — return traces with timestamp <= this; must not be earlier than `since`

name: get_traces
title: Get Traces
